optimization_velocity.stage_rationale: 19 iterations, 22 entries. Three entries now battle-tested (7ca56b8b, 06920986, 056f0a9e). ~60% tasks seen. Metric declining from peak but per-entry performance improving (5/0/6 helpful/harmful/neutral in iter 19). Failures are primarily execution-compliance issues (verification loops, checkpoint violations) rather than missing coverage — the playbook contains correct guidance that isn't mechanically followed. The 12 entries at 0 tests limit signal but aren't causing harm. The main challenge is making commitment entries reliable under context saturation.
optimization_velocity.recent_mutation_success_rate: 3/22 entries with strong positive signals (7ca56b8b +6/-0, 06920986 +5/-0, 843d2ff0 +2/-0). 056f0a9e +5/-3 mixed. 1f931f4e +1/-2 developing. 66f87cbc +1/-1 improving. 12/22 entries at 0 tests.
optimization_velocity.recommendation: The three-iteration metric decline (0.5→0.28→0.28→0.17) is concerning but per-entry metrics are stable/improving — batch composition is the likely driver. The primary challenge has shifted from coverage to compliance: the playbook contains the right entries but the agent violates them during extended sessions. The 66f87cbc snippet-window update tests whether WHY-reasoning improves compliance over pure directives. Continue refining commitment-layer entries with mechanism explanations rather than adding new coverage. Let untested entries accumulate natural exposure.
